description: Context profile for generating static diagrams. Visual language derived from the contour line-art illustrations (flowing parallel lines forming biomorphic shapes).

diagram_language.inspiration: The flowing line-art references: dense parallel curves that build form through spacing variation — tight lines create dark/dense areas, spread lines create light/open areas
diagram_language.line_spacing_logic: Variable — compression conveys depth, shadow, and mass; expansion conveys lightness and surface

stroke_color_modes.use_case: Process or flow diagrams with warm emphasis

composition.negative_space: generous — form floats in space, never fills the frame edge-to-edge

reflection.description: A mirrored ghost of the form below the baseline at reduced opacity (ref: image 1 whale/leaf form)

annotation_style.connector_style: single hairline, no arrowhead or with minimal open arrowhead
annotation_style.placement: outside the form boundary, generous gap

do: Let lines breathe — not every area needs to be dense
Use line compression to simulate shadow organically
Keep the silhouette readable at thumbnail size
Allow slight irregularity in line curves for an organic feel
dont: Use fills or solid shapes — only strokes
Add drop shadows or glows on the lines themselves
Use sharp corners or right angles
